ass02.source: AIG-ASS-02_AI_Risk_Assessment_Worksheet_Proposed.xlsx (v1.10), sheet 'Risk Assessment', A23:A27, C28, C37:C43, E41, A50:A56, C82
triggers: Processing of special category personal data (UK GDPR)
Use in relation to vulnerable residents (children, adults with care/support needs, people experiencing homelessness)
Directly influences housing allocation, social care assessments or homelessness prevention decisions
Novel or first-of-type AI deployment with no prior Council operational experience
Produces or directly informs statutory decisions
Significant AI supplier or model changes that materially alter the risk profile of an existing deployment
Executes actions autonomously without human review of each individual action

evidence_codes.1: E37 Yes + ref, E39 No (no independent check)
evidence_codes.2: E37 Yes + ref, E39 Yes + ref (independently verified)

B1.condition: Two or more of Autonomy, Authority and Reach score 4 or more

B2.condition: Consequence 4 or more and Controllability 4 or more

C2.condition: Any one of the persistence, delegation, tool discovery, credential access or goal adaptation flags

C4.condition: Persistence, delegation or tool discovery flag, together with Autonomy 3 or more or Authority 3 or more

C5.condition: Replication or self-modification flag, or the agent can create new agents

D1.condition: Any mandatory escalation trigger (listed below) is present

calibration_examples.assumed_risk: Medium (9); trigger floors: Critical (rule R3, no per-action review)
High (12); trigger floors: High (housing, vulnerable residents); Critical (rule R3, no per-action review)
High (15); impact floor Medium; trigger floors: Critical (statutory decisions); Critical (rule R3, no per-action review)

minimum_pathway.T4: High (Critical where actions run without evidenced per-action human review — §4.4.6)

agentic_requirement.T0: No minimum pathway and no further agentic triage; as an action-capable use, Gate 2 (agentic control checkpoints) and Gate 6 (permitted autonomy) still apply (R1, R2), and the §4.4.6 floor applies (R3); recorded on the Agent Record (AIG-AGT-04)
agentic_requirement.T1: Normal route (standard AI review); Gate 2 and Gate 6 mandatory; recorded on the Agent Record (AIG-AGT-04)
agentic_requirement.T2: Agentic controls review at Gate 2 (Technical design authority, with AI Governance Working Group input); the forum for the governing pathway decides
agentic_requirement.T3: As T2, plus a formal AI Assurance Board recommendation before the decision
agentic_requirement.T4: High-agency review: as T3, and the AIG-ASS-11 security review (ASI01–ASI10) complete before the Gate 2 decision
agentic_requirement.T5: Executive and safety escalation (SRO and Executive Sponsor oversight; independent challenge); no consequential production use until resolved
